 PM extends Diwali greetings to citizens, says festival symbolises resolve against darkness 
 07 Nov, 2026 
 The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, extended heartfelt greetings to all citizens on the occasion of Diwali.
 The Prime Minister said that the festival of lights illuminates the entire country and reflects the resolve to overcome darkness. He wished that the festival and the times ahead bring happiness, peace and prosperity to everyone.
 Shri Modi said that he celebrates Diwali with great enthusiasm and that, as in previous years, he would continue the tradition of celebrating the festival with the brave soldiers of the country.
 Sharing a video message of Diwali Greetings, the Prime Minister wrote on X;
 “Have a great Diwali!”
 Have a great Diwali! https://t.co/YbFVq7tHmx
— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 7, 2026
